name: Icehound Torann
bio: Torann used to be like any other Winterguard – boastful, arrogant, skilled. But after a Cold Iron spear ripped through his chest, nicking his heart, he became the Icehound; an unrelenting hunter, as cold and tenacious as a winter storm.
